verdict.rationale: OpenTofu ships a first-party `tofu test` command for writing assertion-based tests against configurations. It provisions ephemeral real infrastructure and destroys it after the run, and speculative `tofu plan` lets developers preview changes without applying them. This covers the core of automated, non-production validation, though tests still create real cloud resources rather than running fully offline. Missing for 10: documented mocking/offline test modes or explicit guidance on isolating test runs from production accounts, details on test file syntax and CI integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
